title: Thi Yehi Shaam ke Zindaa'n Mein Sakina ki Fugaa
body:
Thi yehi Shaam ke zindaa'n mein Sakina ki fugaa
Dum ghoota jaata hai goodi mein utha lo amma
1. Kuch sojahaee nahi deta hai andhera zindaan
Haaye is qaid mein ji payega koi insaan
Qaid hum ko kiya zaalim ne jo misle haiwaan
Saas bhi aati hai mushkil se yeh kaisa hai makaan
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Neend aati mujhe baba ka jo milta seena
Hogaya baad e pidar mera tu mushkil jeena
Ab to baba ke bina hai mujhe aansoo peena
Khouff ke mar e kahin tan se nikal jaye na jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mere ammu meri haalat pa zara rahem karoo
Neel go hogaye ruksar e Sakina dekho
Ab suna e nahin deti hai sada kya tumko
Meri awaaz pe aajao chacha tum ho kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Mein khadi rehti thi rootey jo dar e zindaan par
Kuch parindey bhi nazar aate the mujh ko aksar
Shaam hooti hai to wo laot ke jaate hai ghar
Kya kabhi laot ke hum jayenge hoota tha gumah
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jab woh kehti thi sohail aaye they baba jisdum
Roote the sun ke Sakina ki fugaa ahle haram
Qaid khane mein tha ek hasr sa barpa paiham
Nanhe haatoun ko utha kar joh woh karti thi bayan
Azz...Raza Ali sohail.
